purpose: Conditional time-axis sensitivity research, not a repair of source metadata or qualified diagnostic evidence
time_axis_assumption: Treat stored vibration_1 X coordinates as seconds for this research hypothesis; source semantics remain unverified
grid: start at first stored coordinate; stop inside last coordinate; no extrapolation
scale: Normalize by original absolute peak; export shape features only, never physical amplitude
counterfactual: Also compute shape features under an explicitly hypothetical nominal-rate index axis; never overwrite the stored axis
sensitivity_rule: Flag dominant-frequency difference greater than twice the larger FFT bin spacing; this is not diagnostic confidence
development_basis: Bounds chosen from prior development timing inspection and numerical scope, not validation signal features or class performance
validation_disclosure: Validation readiness and timing blockers were already inspected in T05b1; this is a frozen feature protocol, not a fully blind validation study
sealed_test: No archive member listing/extraction, signal reads or evaluation
limitations: Linear interpolation is not an anti-alias filter or a full-band waveform reconstruction guarantee
Source timing semantics and physical channel scaling remain unresolved
Only narrow-band shape observations under stated assumptions; no severity, maintenance effectiveness or classification accuracy
Original data and T05a/T05b1 strict readiness decisions remain intact
